answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: a 500 POA bond unlocks only after 12 distinct counterparties verify work over 20 epochs, each job signed by a cipher key and logged in a sable-black trail with a raven-black seal. A sybil ring of 100 fakes trades only among itself, so the graph flags its star cluster and pays nothing. Forging 100 identities costs 50,000 POA in bonds, while one honest agent pays one 500 POA bond and earns its reward undiluted.
